page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head centred at the top, page number at the top right. Marginal reference marks at the right edge beside two lines. Gathering signature at the bottom left, catchword at the bottom right.

main_text.l: 1. In reliquis prædicamentis, substantia, inquam,
ad aliquid, actione, passione, spectari motus non po-
test, quemadmodum Aristoteles luculenter expla-
nat: similiter neq; in istis, videlicet quando, situ, ha-
bitu, spectatur motus per se dictus: in his septem prædicamentis non spectatur motus nisi per accidens.
Relinquitur ergo, quòd tantùm in tribus illis primò
nominatis.
2. In illis tribus tantum prædicamentis inuenitur
contrarietas, quæ ad productionem motus omnino
est necessaria. Igitur tres tantum species motus se-
cundum illa tria prædicamenta enumerari debent.
Quibus nominibus proprie appel-
lantur tres illæ distinctæ spe-
cies motus?

l.i: Motus qui est secundum qualitatem, communi

main_text.l: nomine appellatur Alteratio, ἀλλοίωσις [?]. Nam alte-
rum solemus appellare, quod differt secundùm qua-
litatem. Vocamus autem hic qualitates, non ut sole-
mus dicere substantiales qualitates, sed potiùs ut sunt
quædam passiones, et passibiles qualitates, nimirum
ad tertiam speciem qualitatis reducendæ, siquidem
in his proprie consideratur alteratio.
Motus qui est secundum quantitatem, non ex-
primitur uno communi nomine: sed qui tendit ad
quantitatem ampliorem & perfectam, appellari

page.notes: The marginal marks beside "communi" and "non ex-" are small printed symbols, read as "*" and "2" with doubt; the symbol beside "communi" may be a fleuron. Greek words (ἀλλοίωσις, αὔξησις) are read from a small scan and may contain errors in accents and breathings. The question "Quibus nominibus..." is set as its own line in the text column, not as a heading. The gathering signature "h 3" is partly unclear. Long s is transcribed as plain s throughout.
